metadata.name: Azure RetireaBot
metadata.description:
This module contains all the components needed to deploy Azure RetireaBot onto your subscription.

>**Note:** This module is currently considered a Proof-Of-Concept. Please review the module and its functionality to see if it matches your and or your customer's use case.
Name or identifier of the container on Azure
The container type on Azure
The target repository for the resources in that container
Optional overrides for advisory handling.
Optional overrides for Azure DevOps authentication, routing, and work item creation.
Optional overrides for GitHub authentication, routing, and issue creation.
Optional overrides for the manual HTTP endpoint.
Optional overrides for lifecycle signal processing.
Optional overrides for Power BI authentication and output.
Optional. A unique application/solution name for all resources in this deployment. This should be 3-16 characters long.

Optional. A unique text value for the solution. This is used to ensure resource names are unique for global resources. Defaults to a 5-character substring of the unique string generated from the subscription ID, resource group name, and solution name.
What work item backend RetireaBot should use to create work items in
What data sink backend RetireaBot should use push data to

(Optional) The NCRONTAB expression that determines how often the timer-triggered function runs. Default: every Monday at 00:00 UTC ("0 0 0 * * 1"). See https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/functions-bindings-timer for syntax.
Configuration for selecting which Azure Advisor recommendations RetireaBot processes.
Configuration for Azure DevOps authentication and work item creation.
Configuration for GitHub authentication and issue creation.
Configuration for generating lifecycle advisories from supported service version policies.
Configuration for the manual HTTP endpoint.
Configuration for Power BI authentication and retirement advisory data output.
